_comment: The triage score formula, shared by agentic/cypherfix_triage/score_model.py (checked by agentic/tests/test_triage_score_vectors.py: score_for, TIER_LEVELS, TIER_LABELS, factor_values and the explanation sentence) and its TypeScript mirror triageLayers.ts (checked by triageLayers.parity.test.ts: tierForScore, TIER_LABELS, TIER_ORDER, FACTOR_KEYS, FACTOR_NAMES). score = 25 x tier_level + 25 x risk. A change to either side fails one of the two tests until this file and the other side follow.
